verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas offers legal document templates and Dashboard-based creation, sending, and tracking of SAFEs. The pack has no evidence of NDA drafting, signature routing, or any Atlas API or MCP server an agent could drive end-to-end. The llms.txt and Markdown docs probes only show that the documentation is machine-readable, which is not a programmatic document or signature capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent draft an NDA and route it for signature end-to-end via the product's API or MCP server
